description: Returns one Theta mainnet transaction by hash (the same data as web.oswave.io/tx/<hash>): type, block_height, timestamp, the full explorer record, and minted_card (v3:N) if it is a BrainVault mint. Read-only, free, no key; counts as 2 calls. Unknown hash: error not_found.
name: theta_tx
title: Theta transaction
